blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — A 15-year-old student was killed while two others, including a 13-year-old boy, were wounded after an unidentified gunman opened fire in Talacogon town. This occurred as the victims were walking home from a municipal-sponsored concert early Saturday, Oct. 24. A report from the Agusan del Sur Police Provincial Office (ADSPPO) submitted to Police Regional Office 13 said that the 15-year-old victim was declared dead on arrival at a local hospital due to gunshot wounds.
